# LeaderShield Funding

> LeaderShield Funding is a network marketing platform for Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) lending and recurring subscription products. Agents earn multi-tiered commissions by referring merchants and recruiting new agents via a binary tree hierarchy.
> URL: https://leadershieldfunding.com

> Brand hierarchy: LeaderShield™ is the parent brand; LeaderShield Funding is its merchant cash advance (capital) arm, delivered alongside the Merchant Growth Platform subscription products.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://leadershieldfunding.com/): Main marketing and recruitment landing page introducing both revenue streams with agent sign-up CTA.
- [Merchant Cash Advance Funding](https://leadershieldfunding.com/funding): MCA product details — funding from $2K to $2M, eligibility, factor rates, repayment terms, and the streamlined intake process.
- [Merchant Growth Platform](https://leadershieldfunding.com/platform): The four subscription tiers (Starter, Growth Foundation, Revenue Growth System, Revenue Scale AI) powered by Marketing Titan + Lead Titan AI.
- [The Agent Opportunity](https://leadershieldfunding.com/opportunity): How the agent business works — two revenue streams, income scenarios, agent toolkit, and the 30-day roadmap.
- [The Compensation Plan](https://leadershieldfunding.com/commissions): Full compensation details — MCA Opening Agent Pool, subscription pools by distributor tier, accelerators, lifetime residuals, agency overrides, and downline income.
- [Income Disclosure](https://leadershieldfunding.com/income-disclosure): FTC-compliant earnings disclosure for prospective agents.
- [Terms of Service](https://leadershieldfunding.com/terms): Platform terms and conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://leadershieldfunding.com/privacy): Data collection and privacy practices.
- [Refund Policy](https://leadershieldfunding.com/refund-policy): Subscription and service refund terms.

## Campaign Pages

- [MCA for Declined Merchants](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/declined): Landing page for merchants who were declined by traditional banks.
- [MCA for Debt Consolidation](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/consolidation): Landing page for merchants seeking to consolidate existing advances.
- [Growth Capital](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/growth): Landing page for merchants seeking growth capital.
- [Seasonal Funding](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/seasonal): Landing page for merchants with seasonal cash flow needs.
- [For Partners & ISOs](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/partners): Partner and call center ISO recruitment page.
- [Become an Agent](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/referral): Agent recruitment landing page covering both income streams — MCA producer commissions and recurring Merchant Growth Platform subscription commissions.

## Products

- **Merchant Cash Advance (MCA):** Capital access for merchants. Agents earn from the MCA Opening Agent Pool (32.5% of the gross funding commission), with performance accelerators up to an additional +2.5%.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 1 (Starter, $149/mo):** 750 verified lead credits/mo, 5 email outreach sequences, Basic AI Brand Intelligence, integrates with existing CRM. Powered by Lead Titan AI.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 2 (Growth Foundation, $497/mo):** Advanced AI Brand Intelligence, native AI CRM (1,000 contacts + scoring), 24/7 AI chatbot lead capture, AI visual email, performance dashboard.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 3 (Revenue Growth System, $997/mo, Most Popular):** Everything in Growth Foundation plus 2,000 lead credits/mo, Darwin AI Chief of Staff, AI social content to Meta, Ask AI, CRM 10,000 contacts + automation.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 4 (Revenue Scale AI, $1,497/mo, Best Value):** Everything in Revenue Growth System plus AI Caller (750 outbound min/mo), AI paid ads + ad designer + insights, social to Meta/LinkedIn/X, AI blogs, CRM 25,000 contacts + advanced automation. Powered by Marketing Titan + Lead Titan AI.

Subscription commissions are paid on the commissionable revenue basis (premium products up to 55%, up to 60% with accelerators), with tiered lifetime residuals (Growth Foundation 10%, Revenue Growth System & Revenue Scale AI 15%; Starter is commission-eligible but not residual-eligible).
